instructions: footprint.openings — voco-style property cards. Body blocks (blank line between each): (1) tag chips csv, (2) location, (3) meta/asset line, (4) scenario accent line, (5) opening teaser, (6) optional https URL only. Patch Airtable: node scripts/patch-footprint-openings-from-fixture.mjs --brand-name Radisson

rows.title: Radisson Riviera Panama
rows.body:
Conversion, Panama, CALA, Beachfront

Chamé, Panamá Oeste, Panama

Conversion · ~92 rooms · Pacific coast

Beach conversion · drive-out leisure from Panama City

Debuted 2025 at Playa Caracol / Punta Chamé—beachfront core Radisson with in-room kitchens, pools, and F&B for families and weekend drive-out from Panama City.

https://www.choicehotels.com/es-mx/panama/panama/radisson-hotels/pn018
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Playa Caracol / Punta Chamé: core Radisson beach resort (not Blu or RED) on Panama's Pacific coast—publicly described as a ~92-room conversion of the former Surfside Hotel with Choice Hotels and Grupo Los Pueblos.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Useful when the owner story is "coastal resort or independent beach asset → Choice distribution + mainstream Radisson flag."
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Shows how core Radisson can anchor a master-planned leisure community without moving to Blu, Collection, or lifestyle sub-brands.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Compare conversion CapEx, PIP timing, and seasonality versus the opening headline—public photos and press are real; RevPAR and fee stack are still deal-specific.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Panama, CALA, Beachfront, Conversion, Pacific coast

rows.title: Radisson Puebla Angelópolis
rows.body:
Meetings, Mexico, CALA, Urban upscale

Puebla, Puebla, Mexico (Angelópolis)

New-build · 80 rooms · meetings + rooftop F&B

Urban greenfield · meetings-capable upscale box

Inaugurated October 2024 in Puebla's Angelópolis corridor—full-service Radisson with spa, rooftop bar, and meeting space for up to ~215 guests.

https://www.choicehotels.com/en-mx/mexico/puebla/radisson-hotels/mxpue
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Angelópolis, Puebla: 80-room Radisson inaugurated October 2024—meetings, spa, rooftop bar, and Mexican–international dining under Choice Hotels CALA.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Illustrates core Radisson as an upscale urban greenfield in a growing Mexican secondary city—not a resort or lifestyle play.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Strong reference when owners want meetings-capable full-service Radisson alongside sibling Choice brands in the same metro.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Treat the inauguration and investment figures as positioning—validate Angelópolis supply, fees, and ramp before underwriting.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Mexico, CALA, Urban upscale, Meetings, Greenfield

rows.title: Radisson San Luis Potosí, Aeropuerto
rows.body:
Airport, Mexico, CALA, Business travel

San Luis Potosí, Mexico (near Ponciano Arriaga Airport)

Airport full-service · 65 rooms

Airport capture · industrial corridor adjacency

Opened February 2025 in Soledad—closest branded full-service hotel to Ponciano Arriaga International Airport and the industrial corridor.

https://www.choicehotels.com/en-mx/mexico/san-luis-potosi/radisson-hotels/slpap
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Rancho Nuevo, Soledad: Radisson San Luis Potosí, Aeropuerto opened February 2025—65 rooms positioned as the nearest branded full-service option to Ponciano Arriaga International Airport.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Useful when the deal is airport capture, corporate transient, and industrial-zone adjacency—not leisure design narrative.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Classic core Radisson (not Blu or RED) for infrastructure-led CALA growth; evaluate O&D versus crew and shuttle economics.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Airport flags win on access and contract mix—model parking, shuttle, and any second Radisson in the metro before using this as a performance proxy.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Mexico, CALA, Airport, Industrial corridor, Business travel

rows.title: Radisson Hotel Paramaribo
rows.body:
Urban conversion, Suriname, CALA, Historic downtown

Paramaribo, Suriname

Conversion · ~126 rooms · former Krasnapolsky site

Historic downtown · adaptive reuse

Official opening October 2025 on Domineestraat—full-service Radisson restoring a landmark downtown hotel with meetings, F&B, fitness, and a preserved historic pool.

https://www.choicehotels.com/suriname/paramaribo/radisson-hotels/sr001
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Domineestraat 39, Paramaribo: core Radisson on the former Hotel Krasnapolsky site—publicly described as a ~126-room conversion reopening the historic city-centre address under Choice Hotels (first Radisson in Suriname).
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Useful when the owner story is "landmark or dated full-service asset in a small CALA capital → Choice distribution + recognizable Radisson flag."
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Shows how core Radisson can re-anchor a heritage downtown corridor—not a resort, airport, or lifestyle sub-brand play.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Compare conversion CapEx, downtown demand mix, and ramp versus the nostalgia headline—opening press is real; occupancy and fee economics remain deal-specific.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Suriname, CALA, Urban conversion, Historic downtown, Full-service
